newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT to sell plastic packaging business.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT to sell plastic packaging business.

text.p: Dutch paper and packaging group KNP BT said on Thursday it was in exclusive talks to sell its worldwide plastic packaging operations to Tenneco Packaging of the U.S.
"Expectations are justified that agreement on this transaction can be reached within the foreseeable future," KNP BT said in a statement.

It said that the size of its plastic flexible and protective packaging activities had been relatively limited, and that it was aiming to concentrate on pulp-based transport packaging. In 1996 it sold its U.S. flexible packaging unit Sengewald USA.
Tenneco Packaging, a fully-owned subsidiary of Tenneco, Inc, is based in Evanston near Chicago. It employs some 20,000 staff and turns over some $4 billion (7 billion guilders) annually, KNP BT said.
KNP BT said its plastic packaging facilities were located in the Netherlands, UK, Belgium, Germany, Italy, Poland, France, Egypt, the U.S. and Canada.
KNP BT Flexible & Protective Packaging employs 3,000 workers and books annual turnover of close on one billion guilders ($560 million), KNP BT said.
